Añades el primer documento o carpeta: You add the first document or folder
Cada agente con su propio token; cada pe: Each agent with its own token; each person with their role in the brain.
Cada paso se marca solo cuando ocurre en: Each step ticks itself when it happens in any of your brains. The list goes away once it is complete; if you close it, it does not come back.
Conectas un segundo agente o invitas a o: You connect a second agent or invite another person
Crea un token de API y conecta tu agente: Create an API token and connect your agent over MCP or the API: before it answers, it will read what the brain knows.
Haces tu primera pregunta en Preguntar: You ask your first question in Ask
Llega la primera propuesta de un agente: The first proposal from an agent arrives
Lo que un agente aprende mientras trabaj: What an agent learns while it works, it proposes; it waits in quarantine until someone reviews it.
Mira lo que recibiría un agente para una: See what an agent would receive for a question, or ask for a written answer with its citations.
Sube ficheros o añade una carpeta como f: Upload files or add a folder as a source: the recall brings their passages too.
Un agente hace su primer recall: An agent makes its first recall
Un curador la aprueba en «Por revisar»,: A curator approves it in «To review», or the decider does if it fits the brain's scope. Only then does it enter the memory.
